routes: /settings/security/api (existing scoped token generation, reveal and recovery)
states: Ready shows the same token, role context, hint, saved guidance and dismissal controls.
A denied clipboard and fallback now leave an inline alert and Select token text beside the visible value; the old toast expired and partially covered Dismiss at 320 px.
A successful deliberate retry restores Copied! without the failure notice. Existing Show remains available in Settings after dismissal.
interactions: The existing Generate form posts only the chosen Agent scopes once. Neither selection nor copy retry issues another token.
Tab and Enter select the exact visible value; desktop Control+C dispatches the native copy event. A tap selects the same exact text in narrow WebKit.
Escape and Dismiss remove the active reveal and selection. Select does not call the clipboard helper.
evidence_summary: Four Playwright 1.56.1 journeys against locked production builds; eight matched capture pairs and two action-only captures reviewed as images. The submitted runtime retained all tested frontend bytes and rebuilt to identical output (203 files). The API and automatic clipboard outcomes were synthetic; the phone OS copy menu and pasteboard were not tested.
